issues.summary: The JS headless test did not actually compare the editor's category, masking-strategy, and version constants against classification-schema.json; only counts and a hardcoded SCHEMA_VERSION literal were checked, so an enum/version drift or a misspelled code could have passed the automated substitute.
issues.fix: Load AccessHarvester.Pipeline/Classification/classification-schema.json in the JS test; assert exact equality between the editor's CATEGORIES codes and schema.definitions.ColumnCategory.enum, between MASKING_STRATEGIES codes and schema.definitions.MaskingStrategy.enum, and between SCHEMA_VERSION and schema.properties.version.const. Add explicit probes for every entry of RAW_VALUE_HEURISTICS (SSN-dashed, SSN-dotted, US phone, email).
issues.fixSummary: Rewrote the JS test's 'constants sanity' section to load the schema file, compare editor constants to the schema enums via a setsEqual helper, and assert SCHEMA_VERSION equals schema.properties.version.const. Replaced the single-SSN probe with a four-entry PROBES list covering every regex in RAW_VALUE_HEURISTICS. Tests still pass: 'node tools/classification-editor-js-test.mjs' -> OK: 8 JS check groups passed.
